hypothesis: Eager publication of both synthetic PDFs before the first Files picker may invalidate LocalStorage item ID to URL resolution; defer B until the first genuine A picker callback.

prior_evidence.current_ios26: A delegate succeeded, B tap had no second delegate; FileProvider -1005 for localstorage/did=4; fixture hash/inode unchanged in later observation.
prior_evidence.se_ios18: Quick Look associated localstorage/did=3 with A and its fixture inode/size before selection; the same ID received FileProvider -1005 after A tap, with no delegate; later fixture hash/inode unchanged.
prior_evidence.exact_ios17: Unchanged UIDocument focused method passed 1/1 with two native callbacks and A2/B1/A1/export assertions; this is separate from cross-platform acceptance.

native_acceptance: One case each on current iOS26.2, SE iOS18.5, exact iOS17.0.1; A visible/B absent before first picker; two deliberate Files selections and actual delegates; per-source read grants; exact A2,B1,A1 output; unchanged originals; native export cancellation retains result.
bounds: Existing 15-second selection transition, 300-second case maximum, 20-minute current/SE focused Test step and unchanged iOS17 combined budget; no retries or URL injection.
limitations: This is an isolated test-fixture experiment, not a production FileProvider repair.
Passing it would implicate eager two-item publication but would not by itself prove why the provider mapping fails.
The macOS host has no Xcode; full iOS typecheck and native behavior require focused CI.
